nodes.name: 01-frame-source-server.md
nodes.summary: Technical recon document for PR3.5 mapping the complete server-side read/write path for the `frame.source` field, including schema DDL, write sites in the frame store, the SELECT projection in workspaces.ts, and the type-contract change needed to expose source provenance to the frontend.

nodes.name: 02-sse-step-path.md
nodes.summary: Technical recon document for PR3.5 tracing the SSE/chat step event path from agent-loop emission through the server streaming layer to the frontend SSE consumer, identifying the exact wiring needed to attach memory provenance metadata to streamed step events.

nodes.name: 03-pr3-hooks-primitives.md
nodes.summary: Truth-table recon for PR3.5 auditing which UI hooks and primitives from PR3 actually exist versus must be built, covering ProvenanceLine component, WarmTone token vocabulary, warm/index.ts exports, and mapping where Memory Trust surfaces live in screen 19.

nodes.name: 04-design-screen19.md
nodes.summary: Build-ready design contract for Screen 19 (Memory Trust), specifying precise component anatomy, CSS class layout, token mappings, stat card trust-summary bar, memory row structure with confidence ring and action buttons, trace view (View B), and a 5-row seed dataset for implementation.

nodes.name: 05-memory-store-api.md
nodes.summary: Capability matrix recon for PR3.5 documenting the real memory-store API surface including the Frame shape, forget/correct/confirm operations, stale/freshness derivation, trace provenance, and the server routes in memory.ts and memory-center.ts exposing memory to the web frontend.
